params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} {{cis|Rek'Sai}} basic attacks and ability hits generate {{tip|fury|{{as|Fury}}}}, which continually expires after a few seconds [[out of combat]].
params.blurb2: When '''Rek'sai''' becomes {{sbc|{{ai|Burrow|Rek'Sai|Burrowed}}}}, she rapidly consumes {{as|Fury}} to {{tip|heal}} herself while she is wounded.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Rek'Sai''' {{tip|basic attacks}} generate {{tip|fury|{{as|25 Fury}}}} {{tip|on-hit}}, reduced to {{as|{{ap|25*0.16}}|Fury}} per hit against {{tip|minions}}, and to {{as|{{ap|25*0.2}}|Fury}} per hit against {{tip|ward|wards}} and [[jungle plants]]. '''Rek'Sai's''' {{tip|abilities}} other than ''{{ai|Queen's Wrath|Rek'Sai}}'' generate {{as|25 Fury}} upon hitting at least one unit. ''{{ai|Prey Seeker|Rek'Sai}}'' does not generate {{as|Fury}} against non-{{tip|champions}} hit. After 8 seconds of being [[out of combat]], she loses {{as|20 Fury}} per second.
params.description2: When '''Rek'Sai''' becomes {{sbc|{{ai|Burrow|Rek'Sai|Burrowed}}}}, she consumes her current {{as|Fury}} over 3 seconds to {{tip|heal}} for {{pp|0 to 100|0 to 100 by 5|type=Fury|key=%|color=Fury}} of {{as|{{pp|9 + (20-9)/17*(x-1) for 20|key=%}} '''maximum''' health}}, stopping once fully consumed or she reaches {{sti|health|{{as|full health}}}}. If she starts generating {{as|Fury}} while {{sbc|Burrowed}}, the consumption occurs after 5 seconds.
params.notes:
* {{tip|Fury}} bar changes from {{color|yellow|'''Yellow'''}} to {{color|red|'''Red'''}} when full.
* When '''Rek'Sai''' automatically consumes {{as|Fury}} while {{sbc|Burrowed}} (no transformation), the healing buff will refresh every second while she has/maintains over {{as|25 Fury}}.{{bug|2}} This causes the healing to last 6 seconds at {{as|100 Fury}}.
* {{Pending for test}} Fury generation with parrying effects ({{tip|blind}}, {{tip|dodge}}, {{tip|block}})

blurb.plain: Innate: Rek'Sai basic attacks and ability hits generate Fury, which continually expires after a few seconds out of combat.

blurb2.plain: When Rek'sai becomes Burrowed, she rapidly consumes Fury to heal herself while she is wounded.

description.plain: Innate: Rek'Sai basic attacks generate 25 Fury on-hit, reduced to 4 per hit against minions, and to 5 per hit against wards and jungle plants. Rek'Sai's abilities other than Queen's Wrath generate 25 Fury upon hitting at least one unit. Prey Seeker does not generate Fury against non-champions hit. After 8 seconds of being out of combat, she loses 20 Fury per second.

description2.plain: When Rek'Sai becomes Burrowed, she consumes her current Fury over 3 seconds to heal for 0% – 100% (based on Fury) of 9% – 21.29% (based on level) maximum health, stopping once fully consumed or she reaches full health. If she starts generating Fury while Burrowed, the consumption occurs after 5 seconds.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Rek'Sai}} empowers her next 3 basic attacks within a few seconds to gain a moderate amount of {{sti|{{as|attack speed}}}} and deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} to the target and surrounding enemies.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rek'Sai''' gains {{sti|{{as|35% '''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for 3 seconds. Her next {{tip|basic attack}} {{tip|on-hit}} within the duration will have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}} and deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} to the target and surrounding enemies. ''Queen's Wrath's'' damage to the primary target is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.
params.leveling: {{st|Bonus Physical Damage|{{as|{{ap|30 to 50}}% AD}}|Total Bonus Physical Damage|{{as|{{ap|30*3 to 50*3}}% AD}}}}

params.notes:
* Damage to the primary target applies {{tip|spell damage}} and damage to secondary targets applies {{tip|proc damage}}.

* When {{tip|dodge|dodged}} or {{tip|block|blocked}}, or if '''Rek'Sai''' is {{tip|blind|blinded}}, the damage dealt to the primary target is nullified, but the damage around her will still occur.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Rek'Sai}} becomes {{sbc|Un-Burrowed}}, gaining access to her {{sbc|Un-Burrowed}} abilities. Additionally, she deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|airborne|knocks them up}}. The enemies and cannot be affected again by ''Unburrow'' for some time.
params.blurb2: '''Rek'Sai''' can automatically cast ''Unburrow'' by basic attacking an enemy, applying the {{tip|airborne|knock up}} against the target.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rek'Sai''' becomes {{sbc|Un-Burrowed}}, gaining access to her {{sbc|Un-Burrowed}} abilities and emerging from the ground to deal {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|airborne|knock them up}} for 1 second. {{tip|Minions}} and small {{tip|monsters}} are instead {{tip|airborne|knocked back}} a short distance. Targets hit cannot be {{tip|airborne|displaced}} by ''Unburrow'' again for some time.
params.description2: '''Rek'Sai''' can also trigger ''Unburrow'' by issuing an attack command, casting the ability once she is in attack range of the target and applying the {{tip|airborne|knock up}} against them.
params.description3: '''''Rek'Sai''' becomes {{tip|lockout|unable}} to move or attack for {{fd|0.15}} seconds after hitting an enemy with Unburrow.''
params.effect radius: {{dv|{{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|220|Knock up radius, center from Rek'Sai to edge of target}}|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|250|Secondary targets are knocked or pulled to this radius around Rek'Sai}}|{{tip|er|icononly=true}} {{tt|75|Rek'Sai's typical attack range for the unburrow via right click}}}}
params.ontargetcdstatic: {{tt|{{ap|10 to 6}}|Begins after the target is displaced}}
params.notes:
* ''Unburrow'' can apply the knock up to minions and small monsters if the ability is cast against them with an attack command.
* ''Unburrow'' does not count as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
* ''Unburrow'' is still considered an ability and is thus stopped by {{tip|silence}}. She can basic attack normally during this time, without leaving ''unburrow''.
* For a brief moment during the beginning animation of {{ai|Tunnel|Rek'Sai|Tunnel}}, '''Rek'Sai''' can trigger ''Unburrow'' by issuing an attack command.
params.tips:
* Due to her reduced range while {{sbc|Burrowed}}, an automatic cast of ''Unburrow'' will always place Rek'Sai at most 25 units before her attack range's reach against a target.
** Note that the ''Unborrow'' effect radius is usually greater than {{tip|er|icononly = true}} 75, meaning Rek'Sai can knock up a single target from slightly further away when she casts ''Unburrow'' the standard way, but may have to walk slightly closer to attack that target afterwards.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Rek'Sai}} {{tip|dashes}} in the target direction and creates a ''Tunnel'' in her wake that lasts for a while. '''Rek'Sai''' can travel through the ''Tunnel'' in either direction, which becomes disabled afterwards for a few seconds.
params.blurb2: '''Rek'Sai''' cannot enter a tunnel while {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}}, {{tip|ground|grounded}}, or {{tip|silence|silenced}}. Enemy {{tip|champions}} can stand on a ''Tunnel'' to destroy it and gain {{g|gold}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rek'Sai''' {{tip|dashes}} in the target direction, leaving behind a ''Tunnel'' that has two interconnected entrances and lasts up to 10 minutes. The ''Tunnel'' can be traversed again when '''Rek'Sai''' targets either entrance, causing her to {{tip|dash}} to the selected entrance before {{tip|dash|travelling}} through the ''Tunnel'' to the opposite side. Once a ''Tunnel'' has been traversed, it is shut down for a few seconds during which '''Rek'Sai''' cannot enter it again.
params.description2: '''Rek'Sai''' can have up to 8 ''Tunnels'' active on the battlefield at once. Deploying ''Tunnels'' beyond the maximum causes the oldest one to be destroyed. Enemy {{tip|champions}} can destroy a ''Tunnel'' by standing on either entrance for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, granting them {{g|5}} upon successfully destroying the ''Tunnel''.
params.description3: If '''Rek'Sai''' attempts to enter a ''Tunnel'' while {{sbc|{{ai|Unburrow|Rek'Sai|Un-Burrowed}}}}, she will automatically ''{{ai|Burrow|Rek'Sai}}'' upon interacting with it, and automatically ''{{ai|Unburrow|Rek'Sai}}'' after exiting it. This does not place ''{{ai|Burrow|Rek'Sai}}'' on cooldown nor trigger ''{{ai|Fury of the Xer'Sai|Rek'Sai}}'', but does trigger other ''Burrow'' effects and ''{{ai|Unburrow|Rek'Sai}}''. If ''{{ai|Burrow|Rek'Sai}}'' is on cooldown at the time of interacting with the ''Tunnel'', the cooldown will be reset.
params.description4: '''''Rek'Sai''' cannot enter a tunnel while {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}}, {{tip|ground|grounded}}, or {{tip|silence|silenced}}.''
params.notes:
* The tunnel cooldown is also incurred for the ''Tunnel'' that '''Rek'Sai''' leaves behind from casting the ability.
* '''Rek'Sai''' will dash to the ''Tunnel's'' selected entrance before entering it only if she is not close enough to it already. If she is on top of the entrance, she will initiate the dash through the ''Tunnel'' instantly after selecting it.
** If she selects an entrance while ''{{ai|Unburrow|Rek'Sai|Un-Burrowed}}'', her dash toward it will last a fixed {{fd|0.6}} seconds instead of the normal dash speed.
* Creating a ''Tunnel'' grants {{tip|sight}} of the area at the other end for 2 seconds.
* ''Tunnel'' entrances can be targeted by allied movement abilities (ex: ''{{ai|Leap Strike|Jax}}'', ''{{ai|Shunpo|Katarina}}'', ''{{ai|Safeguard|Lee Sin}}'', ''{{si|Teleport}}'').
* ''Tunnel'' entrances are {{tip|sight|visible}} on allied champions' minimaps, while enemies must first gain {{tip|sight}} of one before it becomes visible on theirs (the opposite entrance is not revealed).
* Destroying a ''Tunnel'' while '''Rek'Sai''' is traversing it will not prevent her from reaching the opposite entrance.
* '''Rek'Sai''' can ''Tunnel'' through terrain if she dashes close to them and the wall is thin enough to allow the opposite entrance to spawn on the other side.
* If '''Rek'Sai''' issues an attack command while the dash passes by an enemy, the target will be knocked up but '''Rek'Sai''' will still complete the movement.
params.tips:
* Enemies can block '''Rek'Sai''' from using a tunnel entrance if a {{tip|ward}} is placed directly over it, because the cursor's target selection prioritizes wards over tunnel entrances.
* '''Rek'Sai''' will take longer to enter a ''Tunnel'' from ''Un-Burrowed'' state because she needs to become ''Burrowed''.

blurb.plain: Active: Rek'Sai dashes in the target direction and creates a Tunnel in her wake that lasts for a while. Rek'Sai can travel through the Tunnel in either direction, which becomes disabled afterwards for a few seconds.

blurb2.plain: Rek'Sai cannot enter a tunnel while immobilized, grounded, or silenced. Enemy champions can stand on a Tunnel to destroy it and gain gold gold.

description.plain: Active: Rek'Sai dashes in the target direction, leaving behind a Tunnel that has two interconnected entrances and lasts up to 10 minutes. The Tunnel can be traversed again when Rek'Sai targets either entrance, causing her to dash to the selected entrance before travelling through the Tunnel to the opposite side. Once a Tunnel has been traversed, it is shut down for a few seconds during which Rek'Sai cannot enter it again.

description2.plain: Rek'Sai can have up to 8 Tunnels active on the battlefield at once. Deploying Tunnels beyond the maximum causes the oldest one to be destroyed. Enemy champions can destroy a Tunnel by standing on either entrance for 1.5 seconds, granting them 5 gold upon successfully destroying the Tunnel.

description3.plain: If Rek'Sai attempts to enter a Tunnel while Un-Burrowed, she will automatically Burrow upon interacting with it, and automatically Unburrow after exiting it. This does not place Burrow on cooldown nor trigger Fury of the Xer'Sai, but does trigger other Burrow effects and Unburrow. If Burrow is on cooldown at the time of interacting with the Tunnel, the cooldown will be reset.

description4.plain: Rek'Sai cannot enter a tunnel while immobilized, grounded, or silenced.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Passive:}} {{ci|Rek'Sai}} marks enemy champions she damages with ''Marked as Prey'', which lasts a few seconds.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rek'Sai''' selects the target ''Marked as Prey'', becoming {{tip|displacement immune}} and {{tip|vanish|vanishing}} into the ground. After a brief delay, she emerges {{sbc|{{ai|Unburrow|Rek'Sai|Un-Burrowed}}}} and {{tip|dash|pounces}} at the target, dealing {{as|physical damage}} based on {{as|their '''missing''' health}}.
params.blurb4: {{sbc|{{tip|displacement immunity|nolink=true}}:}} The dash cannot be deterred by {{tip|crowd control}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Rek'Sai''' applies ''Marked as Prey'' to enemy champions she damages, lasting for 5 seconds.
params.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rek'Sai''' singles out the target enemy champion ''Marked as Prey'', becoming {{tip|displacement immune}} and {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} and {{tip|vanish|vanishing}} into the ground, as well as {{tip|true sight|revealing}} the target for {{tt|{{fd|1.5}} seconds|From the start of the cast time, estimated}}. After {{tt|{{fd|0.9}} seconds|Estimated, from end of cast time}}, she {{tip|blink|blinks}} to a location {{tt|near the target|Relative to her casting position}}, becoming targetable again and emerging from the ground to {{tip|dash|pounce}} at them. Upon arrival, she slashes at the target with her claws, dealing {{as|physical damage}}, and {{tip|dash|dashes}} 125 units through them.
params.leveling2: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|150 to 350}} {{as|(+ 100% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|15 to 25}}% of target's '''maximum''' health)}}}}
params.description3: ''If cast while in {{sbc|{{ai|Burrow|Rek'Sai|Burrowed}}}} form, '''Rek'Sai''' will automatically {{ai|Unburrow|Rek'Sai}} at the end of Void Rush's cast time, placing {{ai|Burrow|Rek'Sai}} on a 1-second cooldown without triggering Unburrow's effects. If {{ai|Burrow|Rek'Sai}} is already on cooldown, its remaining cooldown is set to 1 second.''
params.notes:
* '''Rek'Sai''' will track the target if they change locations while dashing to them. Once she has started to dash through the target however, she will no longer track them.
** She will dash through the target's previous location without dealing damage if the target moves beyond {{tt|1750 units|Estimated}}.
* If the target moves {{tt|1000|Estimated}} or more units away right before being struck, they will not be dealt the damage.
** In this case, the target is displaced in the moment when '''Rek'Sai''' starts to dash through and prepares to strike them.
* ''Void Rush'' will be cancelled and placed on a {{sti|cd|5-second cooldown}} if the target dies or moves too far away during the cast time or while '''Rek'Sai''' is vanished, or if they are no longer in {{tip|sight}} during the cast time.
** If the ability is cancelled while '''Rek'Sai''' is vanished, she will reappear and emerge from the ground without performing the dash once the {{fd|0.9}}-second delay has elapsed.
** If the ability is cancelled from losing sight of the target, '''Rek'Sai''' will not vanish into the ground after the cast time (but still becoming untargetable) and will remain in place while unable to act for {{fd|0.5}} seconds.{{bug|2}}
** The ability will '''not''' be cancelled if the target becomes {{tip|untargetable}} during the cast time or while '''Rek'Sai''' is vanished.
*** She will still dash to the target even if they are untargetable.
* All sources of damage by '''Rek'Sai''' count for applying the mark.
* '''Rek'Sai''' gains the {{tip|displacement immunity}} from the start of the cast time, and loses it once her dash ends.
* '''Rek'Sai''' can activate ''Void Rush'' either while {{ai|Burrow|Rek'Sai|Burrowed}} or {{ai|Unburrow|Rek'Sai|Unburrowed}}.
** She will always emerge as ''Unburrowed''.
** {{ai|Burrow|Rek'Sai}} will be placed on a 1-second cooldown after ''Void Rush's'' cast even if it is not on cooldown, and will also be set to 1 second even if the remaining cooldown is below that.{{bug}}
* If '''Rek'Sai''' enters {{tip|resurrection}} during the cast time, ''Void Rush'' is canceled and goes on a 5 second cooldown.
** If the ''resurrection'' occurs while {{tip|vanish|vanished}}, she will emerge and pounce the target immediately.
* ''Void Rush'' will not deal damage if the target is {{tip|untargetable}} by the time '''Rek'Sai''' reaches them.
* After vanishing and then emerging, '''Rek'Sai''' will leave behind a temporary, cosmetic {{ai|Tunnel|Rek'Sai}}. She cannot interact with this ''Tunnel'', and each entrance is destroyed {{fd|2.25}} seconds after being spawned from when she vanished or emerged.
* {{iis|Experimental Hexplate}} {{nie|Overdrive}}, {{iis|Fiendhunter Bolts}} {{nie|Opening Barrage}}, and {{iis|Zeke's Convergence}} {{nie|Frostfire Tempest}} activate upon '''Rek'Sai's''' emergence from the ground.
* A screeching noise made by '''Rek'Sai''' can be heard globally after ''Void Rush'' is cast (''will be heard by enemies even if they don't have {{tip|sight}} of '''Rek'Sai''' and/or her destination'').
